# Clerks Award [MA000002]
## Find pay rates and entitlements
Use our tools and resources to:

- [find your award](https://www.fairwork.gov.au/employment-conditions/awards/awards-summary/ma000002-summary#find-your-award)
- [calculate pay rates, penalty rates and allowances](https://www.fairwork.gov.au/employment-conditions/awards/awards-summary/ma000002-summary#calculate-pay-rates-penalty-rates-and-allowances)
- [work out notice periods and redundancy pay](https://www.fairwork.gov.au/employment-conditions/awards/awards-summary/ma000002-summary#work-out-notice-periods-and-redundancy-pay)

### Find your award
If you’re not sure of your award, use our [Pay and Conditions Tool](https://www.fairwork.gov.au/pay-and-wages/pay-calculator).

Awards are also available from our [List of awards](https://www.fairwork.gov.au/employment-conditions/awards/list-of-awards) page.

### Calculate pay rates, penalty rates and allowances
You can calculate pay rates, penalty rates and allowances using our [Pay and Conditions Tool](https://www.fairwork.gov.au/pay-and-wages/pay-calculator).

Prefer a single document? You can also download the pay guide for your award from our [Pay guides](https://www.fairwork.gov.au/pay-and-wages/minimum-wages/pay-guides) page.

### Work out notice periods and redundancy pay
You can find out how much notice and redundancy pay is required under your award using our [Pay and Conditions Tool](https://www.fairwork.gov.au/ending-employment/notice-redundancy-calculator).

### Check your award entitlements
- [hours of work](https://www.fairwork.gov.au/employment-conditions/hours-of-work-breaks-and-rosters/hours-of-work)
